spot.html_text: Challenges to Aristotelianism also came from other modern developments such as international law theory. This is particularly evident with regard to Aristotle’s views on slavery. His Politics was written in a context in which owning slaves was widespread, and he justified the practice through the concept of “natural slavery” (Book I).
